## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-juan **Heian-era Japanese Fǎxiàng (Yogācāra) school bibliographic catalog**, by **Heiso** 平祚 (Japanese, dates not preserved). The **Fǎxiàng** 法相 / *Hossō* school is the Japanese-Yogācāra institutional successor to the Tang **Xuánzàng** 玄奘–**Kuījī** 窺基 Yogācāra tradition. One of the **seven sectarian bibliographies** ([KR6s0125](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0125)–[KR6s0131](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0131)). Preserved at T55 no. 2180. *notBefore* = **950**, *notAfter* = **1100**. Catalog dynasty 日本.
